section: APPENDIX A to ARTICLE 49a Ground Level Uses
APPENDIX A to ARTICLE 49a Ground Level Uses

chunk:
For the purposes of this Article 49A only, except as provided herein, the following
            words and phrases shall have the meanings indicated. "Display Window Area" means that area of any Priority Greenway Frontage of a Proposed
               Project that is between a height of two (2) feet above the ground floor and the height
               of the underside of the floor structure of the second floor of the Proposed Project,
               or fourteen (14) feet, whichever is less. "Greenway Overlay District " or "GWOD" means the area depicted on Maps entitled, "Map
               1, Boston Proper", "Map 1A, Midtown Cultural District", "Map 1C, North Station", "Map
               1G, Chinatown District", "Map 1H, Government Center/Markets District", "Map 1L, North
               En Neighborhood District", "Map 1Xa/1Xb, Central Artery Special District", and "Map
               1E/1F, Harborpark District: North End/Downtown Waterfront", of the series of maps
               entitled "Zoning Districts City of Boston," as amended. "Greenway Parcel" means the following parcels listed in Article 49: Parcels 6, 8,
               10, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17N, 17S, 18N, 18S, 19, 21, 22N, 22S, and 23N. See the Map
               attached as Appendix C to this Article. "Ground Floor Ceiling Height" means the height of the building or structure under
               the floor structure of the second floor. "Ground Level Uses" means the uses listed in Appendix A to this Article. "Priority Greenway Frontage" means the frontage of a Proposed Project that fronts
               on any Greenway Parcel, and the first twenty (20) feet of frontage of a Proposed Project
               on any of the following "Crossroads": Hanover Street, State Street, Broad Street,
               Oliver Street, Northern Avenue, Congress Street, Summer Street, Beach Street, and
               Kneeland Street. See the Map attached as Appendix C to this Article. "Street Wall" means the exterior wall or portion of the exterior wall of a Priority
               Greenway Frontage of a Proposed Project. "Underlying Zoning" means the zoning regulations that are otherwise applicable to
               a Proposed Project or site within the GWOD, including the regulations of any other
               overlay districts as set forth in this Code, without regard to the provisions of any
               applicable PDA Development Plan, PDA Master Plan, or Institutional Master Plan. (Text Amd.
